environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The container runs as root with default seccomp profile. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is applied. The NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP passthrough) and does not inspect HTTP content. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. The instance has IAM role with S3 read access for data ingestion. Flask runs in debug=False mode with gunicorn (4 workers).
